name: Hospitable Quoin
description: Fix the eye on the mark and follow an imagined hawk's drop from the sky down to it.

name: Solarshot
description: Stack two quoins under the breech to raise the muzzle to a steep angle.

name: Twilit Broadside
description: Move the crew a few paces back from the muzzle to clear the wild recoil of a steep shot.

name: Squall Wheelhub
description: Lob a ball over a hill crest so it falls on a hidden camp on the far side.

name: Parity Cascabel
description: Press a weight of qi into the ball so it falls harder from its high arc.

name: Pealcannon
description: Hold the long flight of the high arc in mind and correct for the wind at its crest.

name: Prism Muzzleswell
description: Fire a steep ball through a plank shelter roof onto the men sheltering beneath it.

name: Pulsarrecoil
description: Lay a steep shot from a cliff lip so the ball falls straight onto the ledge path below.

name: Radiance Gunbore
description: Loose two balls on twin steep arcs so they fall one beside the other on the same mark.

name: Triumphant Carriage Banner
description: School move that drops a high-arced volley from the whole battery onto a marked ground like hawks stooping from above.

name: Quoinmercy
description: Count aloud with a partner so two guns fire on matched beats a breath apart.

name: Evanescent Trunnion
description: Pace out a measured gap between two guns so the crews do not foul each other.

name: Wise Breechrope
description: Run a cord along the battery and tie it to each trail to keep every wheel on line.

name: Parity Muzzleswell
description: Swap sponge buckets between guns when one crew falls behind in its cycle.

name: Prism Roar
description: Fire both guns in one crash so the double report throws the enemy into confusion.

name: Squall Bombard
description: Fire the second gun just after the first so its report is lost in the echo of the first.

name: Linstock Troth
description: Let the smoke of both guns drift together into a single bank that hides the crews.

name: Deluge Cannonade
description: Pull one gun back while its pair covers and then swap, so the line withdraws without a gap.

name: Choral Broadside
description: Weave the fire of two guns in alternating beats so the enemy never finds an opening.

name: Millstone Ballshot
description: Fire the whole line in matched pairs down its length so a rolling double report scours the field.

name: Prism Touchhole
description: Time two heavy balls to strike one point a heartbeat apart so the second drives deeper than the first.

name: Magmacannon
description: School move in which the battery fires in matched pairs along the whole line to break an advancing mass.

name: Hospitable Trunnion
description: Test the footing of a dry river bed with a heel before wheeling the gun down into it.

name: Venerable Breechrope
description: Lock the wheels with stones set in the gravel so the gun holds on loose ground.

name: Roarsolace
description: Pace along a curve of the river bed to learn where a column must bunch to pass.

name: Recoil Crown
description: Skip a ball off the hard bed so it travels up the channel along the length of a column.

name: Revelation Cascabel
description: Read the flood marks on the banks to know which ground stays dry and which will bog the gun.

name: Reminiscence Gunbore
description: Count the echo off the bed walls to judge how far the ball ran up the channel.

name: Vigor Wheelhub
description: Pull the gun tight under a bank to shelter it from an enemy gun on the heights.

name: Lordly Ballshot
description: Pour fire into the narrow channel so a column inside it has no room to scatter.

name: Bedrock Quoin
description: Fire a ball at the stones of the bed so their splinters fly among the men below the bank.

name: Steelroar
description: Fire a qi-driven ball along the whole straight of the river bed to cut through every rank it meets.

name: Inferno Cannonade
description: School move that seals a dry river bed with massed fire until the column inside can neither advance nor turn.

name: Quoinbenison
description: Dip a blue banner at the first gun to tell the others the salvo count has begun.

name: Hospitable Touchhole
description: Call the numbers of the guns in order so each knows when its turn falls.

name: Hospitable Muzzleswell
description: Light a row of linstocks from one fire and hand them to each gun in turn.

name: Gloomshot
description: Fire the guns in a fixed order, each a beat after the one before it.

name: Paritycannon
description: Rotate the crews of the guns so those who have fired fall back to load.

name: Cannontroth
description: Fire so that the drifting smoke bank lies between the guns and the enemy skirmishers.

name: Orchestral Recoil
description: Chain the salvo so the fall of each shot is timed to pin foes for the shot that follows.

name: Imperial Recoil
description: Spread the salvo left and right of the first fall so the whole breadth of the line is struck.

name: Linstock Decree
description: Fold the spread of the salvo onto one mark in the last beat so every gun strikes a single point.

name: Imperial Roar Crown
description: School move in which the guns fire in a rolling chain from the banner flank across a wide line.

name: Statute Wheelhub
description: Plant the feet on two chalk lines at shoulder width and take the recoil on the heels.

name: Parityshot
description: Match the breathing of gunner and loader so both finish their parts in one beat.

name: Peal Touchhole
description: Mark the gap between the enemy's blocks with a stake before laying the gun.

name: Pealquoin
description: Check the dry charge tray for caking before a cartridge goes into the bore.

name: Solar Carriage
description: Seat ball and charge with qi from both hands so that they sit as one.

name: Cannonbenison
description: Search the enemy line for its weakest joint by eye and qi sense and set the bore upon it.

name: Unyielding Gunbore
description: Throw a thin ring of qi around the crew to shed splinters flung back by the shot.

name: Evanescent Broadside
description: Step the gun in two short moves to a new lay on the joint of the enemy line.

name: Quenched Linstock
description: Drive a qi-laced ball into the joint between two enemy blocks so it opens the line.

name: Orchestral Ballshot
description: Fire a second ball into the opened seam before the enemy can close it.

name: Vacuum Quoin
description: Charge a heavy ball with the whole qi field and fire it into the centre of a line to split it.

name: Sovereign Prism Carriage
description: School move that opens a hole in an enemy line with a charged ball and widens it with fire on both sides.

name: Vigor Roar
description: Haul the gun up to the basin rim with ropes and a team in a slow steady pull.

name: Quointroth
description: Drive the trail spade deep into the rim so the carriage does not slide when it fires.

name: Trunnion Mercy
description: Walk the rim to see which part of the basin floor is hidden from the other rims.

name: Vigor Breechrope
description: Draw heat from the bore into the core so the barrel stays cool for many rounds.

name: Benevolent Touchhole
description: Lay the bore on the shadow line of the basin floor where the sheltering enemy lies.

name: Lifegiving Wheelhub
description: Read the wind that spills over the rim to correct a ball that must fall far below.

name: Prism Trunnion
description: Sink the recoil of the gun into the rim rock through the core so the carriage never moves.

name: Ruinous Cascabel
description: Fire onto the floor of the basin so every path out is ringed with falling shot.

name: Cannonade Banner
description: Aim a heavy ball at the rim stone below the enemy's feet to split the ground under them.

name: Shotcrown
description: Fire a core-charged ball from the rim so it drives into the basin floor and heaves the ground apart.

name: Imperial Breechrope
description: School move that pours the fire of the whole battery into a basin floor until the ground and all upon it are broken.
